dct_description_sm: The original raw data for the Supplementary Information images is currently unavailable.

This dataset includes the data needed to reproduce the figures in "Photoacoustic Detection of Weak Absorption Bands in Infrared Spectra of Calcite" using the provided code to generate the images as presented in the paper. Each zip file corresponds to the figure with the same numbering in the publication.
